ci : upload API/ABI reports as artifacts (#1666)

The release workflow only shows that the API/ABI check failed, but not
what exactly changed, which makes failures hard to investigate.

Preserve the API/ABI dumps and reports in APIABI_REPORT_DIR and upload
them as a GitHub artifact, so they can be inspected after a failed run.
